description: This file defines an Android Fragment class 'NfcProvisioningFragment' that provides UI and logic for NFC provisioning setup. It manages user inputs for device configuration, creates NFC NDEF messages with provisioning parameters, and handles the interaction with NFC adapter to facilitate device setup via NFC bump.

classes.name: NfcProvisioningFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment providing NFC provisioning UI and logic, including creation of NFC messages with device setup parameters.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and binds event listeners.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets up NFC callback and initializes loader for provisioning values.

methods.name: createNdefMessage
methods.description: Constructs an NDEF message containing device provisioning parameters as a MIME type record.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Updates the provisioning values map based on user input.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates loader to fetch provisioning configuration values.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Populates UI fields with loaded provisioning data.
